text:
jamal: Getting 401 invalid_api_key from the hosted endpoint in staging right after we deployed the helm chart update.
jamal: Quick repro curl (from one of our pods):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/completions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-whatever-example==" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
```

jamal: Response body: 
```json
{
  "error":{"message":"Invalid API key","type":"invalid_api_key","code":401}
}
```

support-bot: Created ticket SUP-3812 and added logs. @support please triage. :folded_hands:

claire: Did you recently rotate the key or change how secrets are templated in Helm values? Saw a lot of 401s after the chart bump in other clusters.

jamal: We didn't rotate keys. We moved the secret from values.yaml plain to a `secrets.apiKey` value that the chart folds. I can share the Helm snippet: 
```yaml
secrets:
  apiKey: >
    sk-ABCDEF0123456789==
```

luis: Ah — can you check what actually got written into the k8s secret (base64 decode) and what the running pod sees? Sometimes YAML folding removes trailing `=` padding if not quoted correctly.

jamal: Checked. In the secret the decoded value is `sk-ABCDEF0123456789` (missing the trailing `==`). The pod env var also shows truncated key (confirmed with `printf "%s" "$API_KEY" | hexdump -C`).

sara: That explains Invalid API key. The server expects the full key with padding. Helm's `>` folded block removed the `=` characters when values.yaml wasn't quoted. This is different from a newline/trailing CR — it's YAML folding/padding loss.

claire: Good catch. Fix is to quote or use `|` or put the key on a single line (no fold). e.g. `apiKey: "sk-ABCDEF0123456789=="` or `apiKey: |\n  sk-ABCDEF0123456789==` in values.yaml.

luis: I patched the helm values with the quoted key and re-applied: `helm upgrade --install`. Redeployed the pods and the calls are succeeding now (no more 401s).

jamal: Confirmed staging calls are green. Thanks all. Leaving the ticket notes about YAML folding and base64 padding so others don't run into this.

support-bot: SUP-3812 marked RESOLVED by luis. :white_check_mark:
